title: Be Present at Our Table, Lord
description: Be Present at Our Table, Lord — the sung grace before meals — in Tonic Solfa (doh is G) to OLD HUNDREDTH, with staff notation and a piano.
about: John Cennick, an English evangelist, published this grace in 1741, with a second verse for after the meal. It is sung to OLD HUNDREDTH, the tune of the Doxology, which is why so many families and fellowships already know it by heart.
underlay: Be pres-ent at our ta-ble, Lord; Be here and ev-’ry-where a-dored; These mer-cies bless, and grant that we May feast in fel-low-ship with thee.

verses.label: Before the meal
lines: Be present at our table, Lord;
These mercies bless, and grant that we
May feast in fellowship with thee.

verses.label: After the meal
lines: We thank thee, Lord, for this our food,
But more because of Jesus’ blood;
Let manna to our souls be given,
The bread of life sent down from heaven.
